# Resume bullets (auto-rendered from results/ by `make paper`; source of every number in RESUME_BULLETS.md.numbers.json)

- Built Dwell, a hybrid physics + gradient-boosting system that predicts per-room direct sun, night noise and summer heat from a phone walkthrough and public geodata; on held-out synthetic buildings, sill-point sun-hour MAE {{ m5/sun.json#methods.hybrid.marginal.mae | .2f }} h/day vs {{ m5/sun.json#methods.single_purpose_baseline.marginal.mae | .2f }} h/day for a sun-path-only tool (`synthetic`; results/m5/sun.json).
- Calibrated every prediction with building-grouped CV+ conformal intervals: empirical 90 % coverage {{ m5/sun.json#methods.hybrid.marginal.coverage90 | pct }} (sun), {{ m6/noise.json#methods.hybrid.marginal.coverage90 | pct }} (noise), {{ m7/heat.json#methods.hybrid.marginal.coverage90 | pct }} (heat) on held-out buildings (`synthetic`; results/m5–m7).
- Designed a Bayesian prior over hidden envelope properties (glazing, frame seal, wall) from interior-scan cues and building metadata: glazing accuracy {{ m8/hidden_properties.json#full.glazing_acc | pct }} vs {{ m8/hidden_properties.json#default_materials.glazing_acc | pct }} for a default-materials assumption, with Sobol analysis attributing {{ m8/sobol.json#noise.hidden_property_share_mean | pct }} of night-noise prediction variance to those properties (`synthetic`; results/m8/).
- Wrote privacy-preserving ESP32 sensor firmware (light, temperature/RH, on-device A-weighted dB levels only) with a CI-enforced static check that raw audio never leaves the level DSP, plus a host-tested DSP suite and an ingestion pipeline deriving sensor targets (firmware/, ingest/).
- Shipped a local-first web app (capture guide, 3D sun-patch time slider, per-room report cards with intervals, "what we couldn't see", side-by-side comparison, illustrative night-listen audio); end-to-end report generation took at most {{ m10/demo_timing.json#max_seconds | .0f }} s per unit on a laptop CPU (spec: < 15 min) (`synthetic`; results/m10/demo_timing.json).
